patterns.title: Transient network or GitHub service interruption
patterns.verification: Retry only a failed explicitly allowlisted test job once; record the next attempt outcome.

patterns.title: Workflow or GitHub permission denied
patterns.verification: Do not change permissions or workflow files automatically. Record the failing step and missing permission.

patterns.title: Private state restore, integrity or persistence failure
patterns.verification: Never initialize, overwrite, force-push or replay production work. Preserve private state.

signatures: exceeds GitHub's file size limit of 100.00 MB
patterns.title: GitHub rejected an oversized database or archive object
patterns.verification: Preserve the private database. Do not rewrite public or private history, force-push, delete state, or retry production persistence blindly. A human must choose a safe storage and migration plan; verify integrity and a successful state commit before reusing any recipe.

patterns.title: Unclassified failure
patterns.verification: Record the diagnosis. Add a recipe only after a fix is tested and verified.
